description.html: This 80x30x120 cm terrarium (288 L) comes with a polystyrene 3D background that faithfully reproduces the texture of stone or bark. Hand-sculpted and painted in natural tones, the background is more than decoration: it adds surfaces for climbing and hiding.

The vertical orientation (120 cm tall) makes this terrarium suitable for arboreal animals, which live in tree canopies and on trunks in the wild. You can add branches, cork and artificial plants to recreate a vertical habitat. The ventilation system with a protective mesh keeps fresh air flowing and prevents moisture buildup.

If the standard dimensions don't suit you, we build custom terrariums. Choose the size, film pattern, background style and extras such as LED lighting or a thermostat. Contact us for a quote. We deliver across Serbia.
